purpose: Copy one file to a new destination and verify source preservation and matching byte hashes.
trigger: Use when a run must operate on an existing baseline without mutating the baseline path.

inputs.name: run_copy_path
inputs.description: New destination file with existing parent.

inputs.name: run_ref
inputs.description: Optional nonempty run reference, checked before copying.

preconditions: Caller supplies run ownership and baseline/evidence role classification. No copy timestamp or byte-size field is returned. A detected copy/source mismatch removes only this helper-created destination and raises.
Caller has established the actual run scope and trustworthy input provenance.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: passed; EX13 returns blocked/eligible and ER11 quarantined/deleted.

outputs.name: baseline_sha256
outputs.description: Source hash before and after copy.

postconditions: Copy one file to a new destination and verify source preservation and matching byte hashes.
Only the declared flat result fields are returned; no desktop or unperformed persistence layer is implied.

implementation.target_environment: Windows host tooling; no SpaceClaim control or geometry mutation is implied.
implementation.notes: Call copy_baseline_model(**payload), or dispatch("EX-05", payload). Rejected inputs raise HostActionError (with code); filesystem failures may propagate OSError. Caller supplies run ownership and baseline/evidence role classification. No copy timestamp or byte-size field is returned. A detected copy/source mismatch removes only this helper-created destination and raises. The linked guide uses conceptual fields; explicitly adapt them to this canonical function interface, never dispatch the guide output directly.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Source/destination are not independent or ownership is unclear.
failure_modes.detection: Canonical paths collide, nest unsafely, or destination ownership is absent.
failure_modes.safe_state: No copy is promoted; baseline is preserved.

recovery.action: Choose a run-owned destination and recheck.
Remove only the failed destination through ER-11, then retry from baseline.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Destination bytes and SHA-256 equal the baseline.

evidence_level.notes: Deterministic host file/event tests passed; one Windows symlink creation test skipped for missing platform privilege. No desktop observation implied.
